title: Standings splits Athletico/Atletico Paranaense into two rows (21 rows for a 20-team season)
evidence: _factual.json raw: 2019 Serie A returns rank 12 'Athletico Paranaense' (27 matches) + rank 21 'Atletico Paranaense' (11 matches); 27+11=38 = one club's real season. soccer.cpp:65 keys the standings map by raw m.home/m.away with no club-alias canonicalization; normalize() (soccer.cpp:35) lowercases/strips accents+state suffix but cannot merge 'athletico' vs 'atletico' (differ by the letter 'h'). Both spellings occur in the SAME source (BR-Football-Dataset.csv: 204 'Athletico' + 222 'Atletico').
suggestion: Add a club-alias/canonicalization table for known dataset spelling variants (Athletico<->Atletico Paranaense) before keying the standings map. NOTE: this is a factual-accuracy defect (already scored by the factual gate, factual_accuracy=0.5), NOT an absent capability — the standings feature itself is implemented and correct for 19/20 clubs, so R9 counts as implemented for requirement_coverage.
